title: The Levites are appointed to serve at the tent of meeting
description: The Lord commands Moses that the tribe of Levi should not be counted with the other Israelites. Instead, the Levites are given responsibility for the tent of meeting: they must carry it, set it up and take it down, serve at it, and camp around it to protect the assembly from wrath. The Israelites did exactly as the Lord had commanded [ref:Num 1:47-54|Numbers 1:47-54].
